# PathLearn™

> PathLearn™ is the certification training portal of Accumentum®. Approved Accumentum students use one login for expert-led training modules, hands-on labs and practice quizzes, on the web at training.accumentum.net and in the PathLearn™ iPhone app. Progress syncs between web and iPhone.

PathLearn™ is a product of Accumentum, LLC, Austin, Texas, serving learners across the United States. Access follows Accumentum registration and approval. Downloading the app alone does not create enrollment. PathPass® is a separate Accumentum exam-prep practice bank app.

## Main pages
- [PathLearn home](https://pathlearn.net/): the official PathLearn™ site. What PathLearn is, what is inside the portal, access, how it works, FAQ
- [PathLearn on accumentum.net](https://accumentum.net/pathlearn/): short PathLearn summary on the Accumentum site
